get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit by model name with optional inference settings and device
get_reference_energies: get atomic or formation elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint file path for a named pretrained model
available_models: list all available pretrained model names registered in the fairchem calculate module
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass that stores model filename, repo ID, subfolder, and reference energy metadata
